SET:C.meaning: weapon types; six types: thermal, acoustic, radar, laser, jammer and point-defense

PARAM:p_cwm.meaning: base probability weapon w of type c intercepts missile m if assigned

PARAM:pi_cwm.meaning: base conditional probability weapon w of type c destroys missile m if it intercepts

PARAM:r_min_cw.meaning: minimum and maximum range of weapon w of type c

PARAM:r_max_cw.meaning: split registry entry for grouped source item

PARAM:psi_m.meaning: split registry entry for grouped source item

PARAM:eta_m.meaning: split registry entry for grouped source item

PARAM:beta_cw.meaning: split registry entry for grouped source item

PARAM:theta_prime_cw.meaning: split registry entry for grouped source item

PARAM:gamma_prime_cw.meaning: split registry entry for grouped source item

PARAM:lambda_cm.meaning: 1 if weapon type c can counter missile guidance type of missile m

PARAM:rho.meaning: maximum expected destruction/overkill-control threshold used in source constraint (14)

PARAM:dis_cwm.meaning: distance between weapon w of type c and missile m

PARAM:pi_prime_cwm.meaning: split registry entry for grouped source item

PARAM:st_cw.meaning: setup time and time required for missile destruction in dynamic interval calculation

PARAM:lt_cwm.meaning: split registry entry for grouped source item

PARAM:vl_m.meaning: missile speed for dynamic coordinate updates

VAR:x_cwm.meaning: 1 if weapon w of type c is assigned to missile m at the current stage

VAR:x_cwmk.meaning: dynamic-stage version of assignment decision when the wrapper is active

OBJ:OBJ1.meaning: minimize weighted residual survival / wasted threat value; equivalent to maximizing missile destruction in the source

CON:C1.meaning: each weapon except jammer can be used against at most one missile at a time

CON:C2.meaning: each missile receives at least one eligible defensive assignment when considered in the static stage

CON:C5.meaning: jammer assignment requires missile within horizontal coverage

CON:C6.meaning: jammer assignment requires missile within vertical coverage

CON:C7.meaning: weapon guidance-type compatibility, point defense can engage any type at close range

CON:C8.meaning: prevents excessive assignment to a missile after sufficiently low survival probability

SEMANTIC:DYNAMIC_UPDATE.meaning: dynamic update or staged wrapper semantics

SEMANTIC:unsupported_hard_kill_missile_i.meaning: hard-kill missile interceptor model replacing soft-kill weapon types

SEMANTIC:unsupported_target_threat_resid.meaning: target threat residual objective unrelated to soft-kill residual survival product

SEMANTIC:unsupported_weapon_inventory_fo.meaning: weapon inventory for types not tied to W_c sets

SEMANTIC:unsupported_time_windows_as_sub.meaning: time windows as substitute for stage update dynamics
